docs.summary: A named morph target attached to a [`Mesh`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Mesh). Each frame represents one fully-deformed shape; intermediate weights between two frames are interpolated linearly.
docs.remarks: glTF morph targets always have a single frame; FBX and some legacy formats can carry multiple. Names come from `mesh.extras.targetNames` in glTF or the `Shape` name in FBX.

docs.summary: One or more deformed frames; weights interpolate between them.
